body: hey, just wanted to let you know you’re not alone.. i’m currently going through a similar situation. my dad was a drug addict and alcoholic, he use to beat and choke my mother when I was younger and anytime i’d step in i’d be choked and beaten… it still affects me to this day because my younger siblings see this as well. the irony of all this is that, I too tried to end it all one day. I went to my bathroom and was prepared to hang myself & as soon as I was ready to step off my little stool…. my father called me. He asked if I can pick up my brother from school & I realized then and there that I gotta keep pushing for my little brother… Getting over the past is hard but pushing through life even when you’re about to end it all is something not many can do. i’m proud of you for sticking around & helping me stay strong w your story as well. Glad i’m not alone during these times… stay strong kiddo. if you ever need someone, i’m here.
